smell_elimination.justification: The refactoring completely eliminates the interface segregation smell. All six write-related stub methods (encode, encode_variable, encode_attribute, set_dimension, set_attribute, prepare_variable) have been removed from PydapDataStore. No residual smell code, unused imports, or orphaned helpers remain. The read-only store is now pure and free from write interface dependencies.

cross_file_coordination.justification: Excellent cross-file coordination. The refactoring introduces AbstractReadableDataStore and updates type annotations across all relevant files (api.py, common.py, h5netcdf_.py, netCDF4_.py, plugins.py, pydap_.py, scipy_.py, store.py, zarr.py, conventions.py). The new type is properly exported in __init__.py. All references to AbstractDataStore for read-only operations have been consistently updated to AbstractReadableDataStore.

structural_soundness.justification: The solution introduces a proper inheritance hierarchy following Interface Segregation Principle: AbstractReadableDataStore defines the minimal read interface, AbstractDataStore extends it to add write operations. This allows read-only implementations (PydapDataStore) to inherit only what they need, while writable stores get the full interface. Clear separation of concerns with appropriate abstraction levels and proper single responsibility.

code_quality.justification: The code is clean, idiomatic, and well-documented. The new AbstractReadableDataStore class includes clear docstrings explaining its purpose and relationship to Interface Segregation Principle. AbstractDataStore also has updated documentation clarifying when to use each base class. Naming is intuitive (AbstractReadableDataStore clearly conveys read-only nature), and the changes are minimal yet complete.

interface_decomposition.justification: Interfaces are split along cohesive responsibility boundaries: AbstractReadableDataStore contains only read operations (get_dimensions, get_attrs, get_variables, load, get_encoding, encode methods), while AbstractDataStore extends it with write operations (set_dimension, set_attribute, prepare_variable, set_variables, store). The decomposition is logical and follows the natural read/write distinction.

split_quality.justification: All unnecessary stubs removed from PydapDataStore. Each interface is focused and appropriately sized—AbstractReadableDataStore provides sufficient functionality for read operations without being overly narrow, and AbstractDataStore adds write capabilities without bloat. The granularity is ideal: not too coarse (forcing unwanted methods) nor too fine (fragmenting into trivial interfaces).

read-only_store_interface_purity.justification: PydapDataStore now contains zero write-related methods. All six stub methods (encode, encode_variable, encode_attribute, set_dimension, set_attribute, prepare_variable) have been completely removed. The class inherits from AbstractReadableDataStore and only implements genuinely needed read operations. Perfect Interface Segregation Principle compliance achieved for read-only implementations.

write_interface_architectural_separation.justification: Clear architectural boundary established: AbstractReadableDataStore defines read-only interface, AbstractDataStore extends it with write operations. Write-specific methods (set_dimension, set_attribute, prepare_variable, store, set_variables) are defined only in AbstractDataStore. PydapDataStore inherits from AbstractReadableDataStore (read-only), while writable stores inherit from AbstractDataStore. The separation is clean, enforceable through type system, and consistently applied throughout the codebase.

aspect_3_judge.summary: This is an exemplary refactoring that perfectly addresses the interface segregation violation. By introducing AbstractReadableDataStore as a focused base class for read operations and making AbstractDataStore extend it for write operations, the solution eliminates all stub methods from PydapDataStore while establishing a clear, type-safe architectural boundary. The changes are comprehensive, well-coordinated across all files, and demonstrate textbook application of Interface Segregation Principle.
